known_gaps: The pane's instance tabs are pane-scoped: a window reload or a working-set apply on the group starts the panel empty again. The instances are disposed with the pane (verified: no /bin/zsh -il process survived), so nothing leaks, but the tabs are not restored. Moving the tab model into a contribution that owns the instances is the next slice.

The reference panel is wide enough for text labels on its four entries; this column is 322px, so the strip entries are icons with tooltips and the labelled form of the same entries is the tile grid in the empty body.
The reference's `Open new tab menu` is a menu of the four apps; Caret's new-instance control creates a terminal, and the four entries stay reachable in the strip.
The pinned summary shows the real active session; the empty home has no session, so it reports that instead of hiding.
